verdict.rationale: Clara documents its own card issuance: cards can be created, updated, locked/unlocked and deleted. A "VIRTUAL" card type is active immediately with no activation step, which supports issuing "in minutes". Each card carries its own limit/threshold with a configurable reset periodicity (monthly, weekly or daily), plus optional merchant and time restrictions. missing for 10: explicit evidence of physical card issuance (only implied by the existence of a VIRTUAL type), evidence of no-code issuance from the dashboard for a non-developer founder, independent or hands-on corroboration.
